verdict.rationale: Convertio is a cloud file-conversion service. A SaaS tool of this kind could plausibly add AI features such as document summaries or conversion suggestions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only format conversion, OCR, API/CLI access and pricing, with nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data. OCR is text extraction, not AI insight, and is an adjacent feature at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
